expect_red: a feature row's suggestion: an open proposal at its end, else the contact engine's candidates with the top one's face at this end, and nothing once the end is bound

mutations.contract: A candidates end lights the contact engine's TOP-ranked face, whatever order the projection lists them in.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff a_rail_row_with_a_proposal_says_so_and_accepts_it_in_place (2026-10-29). Taking the first-listed candidate lights a lower-ranked face.
mutations.find: var top = candidates.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return a.rank - b.rank; })[0];
